title: Autism prevalence range across ADDM sites, 2022 (per 1,000)

source.name: Autism and Developmental Disabilities Monitoring (ADDM) Network
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: The 2022 ADDM report's 16 sites ranged from about 1 in 103 (Laredo, Texas, ~9.7 per 1,000) to about 1 in 19 (a California site, ~52.6 per 1,000) — the ADDM Network is explicitly not a representative national sample, so site-to-site variation reflects screening access as much as true prevalence.
